title: StoredFile

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this stored file. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

source.description: How the stored file was created

message_id.description: ID of the message associated with this file, if any. Files associated with a message are deleted automatically when the message is deleted.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file content (lowercase hex), if available

time_created.description: Time the file was created in Telerivet

user_id.description: ID of the Telerivet user who created the file (if applicable)

url.description: URL where the file content can be downloaded. Note: this URL is temporary and may not be valid for more than 1 day; retrieve the stored file again to get a fresh URL.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of a thumbnail image for video files, if available. Note: this URL is temporary and may not be valid for more than 1 day.

project_id.description: ID of the project this file belongs to

description:
Represents a file stored in a Telerivet project, such as a media attachment for outgoing messages.

 Stored files are also automatically created for media attachments for incoming messages.

 Files can be uploaded via project.uploadFile, then attached to outgoing messages by passing the file ID as a `file_id` item in the `media` parameter when sending a message or broadcast.
